name: EL ENCANTO SD
blocked: Restaurant's own site (elencantosd.com) is a GoHighLevel landing-page funnel: it names dishes (Tabla de Quesos y Carnes Frias, Chipotle Omelette, Pollo en Mole, Green Chilaquiles, Salmon Encanto, etc.) as a marketing showcase with no prices anywhere in the page. Ordering is through joe.coffee (found via Serper), a client-rendered SPA with no readable API/JSON payload in the served HTML - needs a browser. Yelp's menu tab is barred by policy; did not have time to page through Yelp photos for a dated menu image. A DoorDash 'Encanto Cafe' hit is a different address (1261 Prospect St, La Jolla) and not this restaurant.

name: Graziano's Pizza Oceanside
notes: Restaurant's own domain (grazianosoceanside.com) is behind a Sucuri/sgcaptcha bot wall; read instead from the restaurant's own Toast storefront (window.__OO_STATE__ Apollo cache, full catalog embedded, not metadata-only). Cent distribution overwhelmingly whole-dollar (91/102), a handful of side/sauce add-ons at .50/.69/.75/.93 - no markup divisor pattern. Price level matches independent snippets seen via search (14" Cheese $18, Cauliflower Crust Cheese $17). '12" Subs' show one price each; the storefront elsewhere advertises Half/Whole sizing, so these may be the half-sub base price with whole as an unread modifier option - recorded as shown, not derived. Dropped one $1.39 'Pinwheel Spinach Artichoke' filed oddly under the Pizza group (kept as-is, plausible finger-food price).

name: Mariscos Mi Gusto Es
notes: Router found 'no known platform' on the mobile-webview6.com landing shell, but that shell links a first-party MenuStar ordering backend at themenustar6.com (restaurant_id 13302) with 10 categories. Fetched every category via POST function=get_items against functions/restaurant.php and parsed the returned item HTML directly. All 74 dishes with round-dollar/half-dollar pricing; matches independent Yelp snippet ('Mar y Tierra taco at $7 per taco').

name: Nana's and Pops Sweet Shop
blocked: Router reported a connect-timeout on www.osidesweets.com; the domain is also unreachable from this session (direct curl and in-app browser navigation both failed/timed out). Read the site instead via Wayback Machine snapshots (home page 2026-05-12, /shop page 2026-02-18): it's a GoDaddy Website Builder storefront (ice cream/candy/jewelry) whose product catalog renders client-side - the archived static HTML carries category labels and product names (Choco Taco, fudge, taffy, magnets) but zero prices anywhere. Ice cream/candy shops of this kind typically price by scoop/weight at the counter rather than a fixed menu. No DoorDash/Grubhub/Toast listing found via search. Open and operating (recent reviews, 2025 copyright on shop page) - not closed.

name: Nory's Donut & Bakery
blocked: Restaurant's own site (norysbakery.com, which has a real '/menu-&-price-list' page per its own nav: Donuts / Pastries & Desserts / Cakes / Drinks) is unreachable from this session (connect timeout, matches router's own finding) and its Wayback snapshot is a GoDaddy Website Builder shell with categories but no client-rendered item data. Fell back to DoorDash's own Next.js RSC payload (parsed via escaped-JSON field extraction), which returned only 2 of the site's 4 advertised categories (Donuts, Drinks - 9 unique dishes) plus 'Most Ordered'/'Featured Items' carousels that reference OTHER items (Napoleon Pastry, Croissant, Fruit Tart, Cream Puff Pastry, Raspberry Eclair) never listed under any captured category - the signature of a truncated DoorDash capture missing Pastries & Desserts and Cakes per AGENT-BRIEF's DoorDash-truncation warning. Did not file a partial catalog.

name: La Malcriada Birrieria y mas
notes: No website/router data in the batch. Found via Serper: a second, newer location of a National City birrieria (Instagram: 'Nuestra segunda sucursal ya esta abierta' - our second location is now open), listed live on DoorDash (Uber Eats shows this address as 'no longer available/closed' but that is a marketplace-listing status, not the business - Instagram is posting current promos for this address). Parsed DoorDash's Next.js RSC payload the same way as restaurant 7006: found exactly 3 real category names (Birria Specialties, Extras, Bebidas) plus a 'Most Ordered' carousel whose 12 items are ALL duplicates of items already in those 3 categories (verified no orphan carousel items, unlike the Nory's Donut capture) - no sign of truncation. 17 unique dishes. Confidence medium rather than high because this is a marketplace (not first-party) source and a couple of Instagram promo prices seen in search snippets (e.g. a 15-taco box quoted at $44 or $53 in different posts) differ from DoorDash's $60 box, consistent with either promo/deal pricing or marketplace markup on the box item specifically - flagging, not filing those Instagram numbers.

name: BEAURISTA COFFEE
blocked: Router already screened this domain out for a markup pattern on products.json. Confirmed directly: fetched products.json (74 products / 124 variant prices) and the ENTIRE catalog is retail merchandise and bagged coffee for shipping/online sale (hats, headcovers, tees, Yeti mugs, roasted-bean bags, pods) - product_type is literally 'Merchandise'/'Coffee'(beans)/'Bundle'. There is no drink or food menu item anywhere in the store (no Latte, Cappuccino-as-drink, Cortado, pastry, etc.) - this is a drive-thru espresso stand at the Del Mar Golf Center whose website is purely an e-commerce shop for beans/gear, not an ordering menu. No DoorDash/Uber Eats/Toast listing found via search; zmenu hit is a barred tier-5 aggregator. Business is clearly open (active Shopify store, recent Yelp activity) - not closed.

name: The Original Kebab
notes: Batch listed only an Instagram link, but Serper found the restaurant's real first-party ordering site (theoriginalkebabmenu.com), which embeds a clean JSON menu payload (categories -> products, with id/name/price/description) directly in the page HTML - extracted via brace-counting from the 'categories":[' array. 8 categories, 37 dishes. Prices match independent Seamless/Uber Eats snippets seen via search (Combo Plate $23.99, Gyros $14.99, Chicken Shawarma Plate $19.99) confirming no marketplace markup on the first-party site.
